description.value:
You can cast the phasestrike power without spending force points. The bonus damage of the attack made during phasestrike rises to 2d8 at 11th level and to 3d8 at 17th level.

Additionally, whenever you spend your action casting an at-will force power, you may also use your Martial Arts or Focus features. You can combine these uses a total of three times, gaining one more at 9th, 13th, and 17th level, and you regain all spent uses after a long rest.
